The Residence Inn Los Angeles LAX/Century Boulevard is a 12-story, 231-suite extended-stay hotel located at 5933 West Century Boulevard in the Westchester neighborhood of Los Angeles, California, less than half a mile from Los Angeles International Airport (LAX). Part of the Residence Inn by Marriott brand, the hotel opened in March 2015 and was the first new hotel to open near LAX in 23 years at the time of its debut. The hotel is owned by Seaview Investors, LLC and managed by Azul Hospitality Group.
History
The Residence Inn LAX/Century Boulevard was developed through the adaptive reuse of a 215,000-square-foot office building on West Century Boulevard. Seaview Investors, LLC, led by Robert Alter, acquired the property and undertook its conversion into an extended-stay hotel under the Residence Inn by Marriott brand. The hotel opened in March 2015, marking the first new hotel opening in the LAX area in over two decades.
The property is managed by Azul Hospitality Group, a hotel management company headquartered in San Diego, California.
Design and features
The 12-story hotel contains 231 suites, which are among the largest hotel suites in the LAX area, ranging from 450 to 980 square feet. All suites feature full kitchens equipped with a microwave, full-size refrigerator, stovetop, and cookware. Room configurations include studios with one king or two queen beds, as well as one- and two-bedroom suites. Some suites offer direct views of the south runway at LAX.
Amenities
The hotel offers a complimentary hot breakfast served daily. Three onsite dining options are available: a Starbucks, a Jersey Mike's, and Antonio's Artisan Pizza.
Additional amenities include an outdoor swimming pool, a fitness center, a terrace with barbecue facilities, 2,000 square feet of meeting and event space, a convenience store, on-site laundry facilities, and electric vehicle charging stations. The hotel provides a complimentary 24-hour shuttle service to and from LAX.
